name: Bluddle
summary:
Welcome to Bluddle! Bluddle is a VR game first of its time to make an egg hatching and pet growing game. Play with up to 4 people in a lobby and show off you pets!

How to play:
Buy an egg from shop
Place the egg in your assigned plot
Wait for the egg to hatch and wait to see what pet you get
when hatched you can see what pet you got
the pet will then dig up items
go to the sell stand to sell your items and or pets
show off your rare pets and items to friends 
Remember, Have fun!

Be sure to stay safe onlin
